model_annotation: The plot illustrates how coverage changes as the number of completions \(k\) increases, with four lines corresponding to different model settings shown in the legend. The x-axis is labeled “Number of completions (\(k\))” and uses a base-2 logarithmic progression indicated by tick labels from \(2^0\) through \(2^8\) (i.e., 1 to 256), with one tick at each power of two. The y-axis is labeled “Coverage,” displayed on a linear scale with labeled ticks at approximately 0.2 intervals (0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8) and values extending to just above 0.9. The “Llama-3B” series is drawn as a medium-blue solid line with square markers and increases steadily from about 0.43 at \(2^0\) to about 0.93 at \(2^8\). The “Llama-3B + FT” series is shown as a green dotted line with upward triangle markers and rises from about 0.43 at \(2^0\) to about 0.93 at \(2^8\), closely tracking the blue 3B line across the axis. The “Llama-1B” series appears as a light-blue solid line with circular markers, increasing from roughly 0.25 at \(2^0\) to about 0.92 at \(2^8\). The “Llama-1B + FT” series is shown as a pale-green solid line with upward triangle markers and increases from about 0.28 at \(2^0\) to about 0.87 at \(2^8\), with all series exhibiting a generally monotonic upward trend and no visible decreases between successive \(k\) values.
